_comment: Each entry lets ONE citation in ONE row/mode stay as cited despite ONE named newer record of
the same campaign and mode. No wildcards, no campaign-wide or implicit-historical entries.
An exception authorizes retaining that citation only; it never authorizes weakening a verdict
or a ratified spec. Unused, duplicate or dangling entries fail the check: when the newer
record is cited, or the citation moves, delete the entry in the same PR.
